It is in an appendix to collected editions of [Mrs.

Hemans](/person/1936)’ life and works, where she had made notes of subjects from history suitable to write poems upon, unluckily without saying where they came from. I have watched for this story for years . . . I will write to the friend who owns the copy of Mrs Hemans from which I took it.[^1]


[^1]: [Alfred Tennyson](/person/1874) had asked [Warburton](/person/1466) (later a canon of Winchester but at that date an inspector of schools) to find out from CMY the source of the story, ‘Odin’s Sacrifice’, in the [Book of Golden Deeds](/book/51).

On 6 June 1865, he quoted this extract from one of two letters he had received from her.

Tennyson used the story in his poem \'The Victim\'.
